purpose: Compare genuinely different full-hierarchy learned sequence families after the world-space selector and Transformer hard stop.

representation.state: Root translation plus 23 ancestor-local continuous 6D rotations in fixed body-scale units.
representation.controls: Exact authored root and rotation masks; helper joints never authored.
representation.output: Full local-state residual around a deterministic sparse-key procedural baseline, followed by exact control projection, forward kinematics, limits, contact/balance/collision refinement and original-rig validation.

data_boundary.weak_contact_training: Allowed only as an opt-in low-confidence feature, with contact-condition dropout at 0.5.
data_boundary.weak_contact_development: Forbidden when derived from hidden target motion. The primary development condition is unknown contact; an authored/measured-contact condition may be added only with independent input provenance.
data_boundary.metadata: Description/style labels retain metadata provenance and confidence <= 0.5.
data_boundary.scene_and_hand_contacts: Unknown unless independently measured or reviewed.

candidates.input: Procedural state, 483-feature conditioning, observed masks, and a leak-resistant 142-feature immediate boundary-motion block derived only from previous-to-start and end-to-next observed frames.
candidates.output: One residual full hierarchy state sequence.
candidates.capacity: 128 channels; six residual blocks with dilations 1,2,4,8,16,32; under 3 million parameters.
candidates.why: Fast deterministic proposal suitable for responsive CPU/ONNX inference and a non-attention baseline. Its 253-frame receptive field covers the maximum 97-frame input without an encoder-decoder hierarchy.
candidates.inference: One forward pass plus deterministic refinement.

candidates.input: Noised full local state, procedural baseline, 483-feature conditioning, observed masks, leak-resistant immediate boundary motion and diffusion timestep.
candidates.output: Velocity or residual target over the full hierarchy sequence.
candidates.capacity: 128 channels; four temporal scales; classifier-free contact/style dropout; under 8 million parameters.
candidates.why: Represents multiple plausible inbetweens under partial controls without choosing among precomputed curves.
candidates.inference: DDIM with 4, 8 and 12 steps, each followed by exact control projection.

shared_training.baseline: Deterministic sparse-key baseline is always measured and never relabelled as learned.
shared_training.loss: Masked local rotation, root, semantic FK position, rotation, velocity and acceleration losses; exact authored controls have zero learned freedom.
shared_training.loss_scale_evidence: Frozen before model outcomes from 100 deterministic training-only windows, 20 per gap. Weighted means: root 0.06457, position 0.10403, rotation 0.06324, velocity 0.05891, acceleration 0.10554, contact 0.01918. No development or confirmation motion was read.
shared_training.training_selection: Select only from subject-disjoint future-development aggregate and worst-cohort results; do not open confirmation.
shared_training.confirmation_promotion: Only after one fixed candidate and export package pass all development gates.

acceptance.old_development_gates: All retained prior gates must pass without dilution.
acceptance.future_development_cohorts: No aggregate-only win: every declared task/gap cohort must be reported and worst-cohort regression is a rejection.
acceptance.unreviewed_contact_claim: Cannot qualify physical contact, penetration, naturalness or intent.
acceptance.runtime_promotion: Requires original-rig lifecycle/undo/keep-discard checks, ONNX parity and measured Bforartists latency.

latency_budgets.training: GPU permitted only in isolated local training environment.
latency_budgets.deployment: Bforartists core must have a CPU ONNX Runtime or pure local equivalent; no torch, online account or paid service dependency.
latency_budgets.measurement: Measure 8/16/32/64/96-frame windows separately on the target Bforartists host; do not extrapolate from desktop Python.

hard_stops: No more nearby world-space selector, mixture, Transformer or loss-weight variants.
No contact input derived from hidden development or confirmation target motion.
No runtime promotion from training fit, synthetic reconstruction or a single rig family.
No Cascadeur parity/surpass claim without direct documented comparison and animator assessment.
